sources.snippet: Description: Higgs Audio v3 STT is a speech-to-text model from Boson AI combining a Whisper-Large-v3 encoder with a Qwen3 decoder (2.68B total parameters). It is the ASR sibling of the Higgs Audio v3 TTS model (higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b), sharing the same Qwen3 decoder family but specialized for speech recognition rather than speech synthesis.

sources.title: AI Video Agent for Marketing Teams | Synthesys
sources.snippet: Multiple frontier models working together through multi-model orchestration — Sora 2, Google VEO 3.1, Wan 2.5, Kling 3, Seedream, and others. Rather than relying on a single AI engine, the system routes each task to the model that handles it best: one for photorealistic rendering, another for natural motion, a third for voice synthesis.
